Class Hall

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.Hall
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, VirtualHallServer, Serializable, Remote
public class Hall extends Object implements VirtualHallServer, Serializable
The Hall class acts as the main lobby of the game application. It manages players who are currently not in any game, handles the creation and joining of game rooms, and broadcasts lobby updates to all connected users. It implements VirtualHallServer to expose hall commands and is Serializable to support server state persistence.

  • Method Details

    • setServer

      public void setServer(ServerMultiplexer server)
      Sets the server reference for this hall. Useful for initialization and recovering state after a server crash.
      Parameters:
      server - the ServerMultiplexer instance handling the main connections.

    • enterPlayer

      public void enterPlayer(PhasedProxyPlayer newPlayer) throws Exception
      Registers a newly connected or returning player into the hall. It binds the player to the hall environment, updates their client phase, sends them the initial lobby state, and broadcasts the updated hall to everyone else.
      Parameters:
      newPlayer - the proxy representing the client joining the hall.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the connection or packet transmission.

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect(DisconnectPacket disconnectPacket) throws Exception
      Handles the explicit disconnection of a player who is currently in the hall. Removes the player from the active hall list, updates the remaining clients, and notifies the main server.
      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface Disconnectable
      Parameters:
      disconnectPacket - the packet containing details about the disconnecting player.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the disconnection broadcast.

    • joinRoom

      public void joinRoom(HallJoinPacket hallJoinPacket) throws Exception
      Processes a player's request to join an existing game room. Moves the player from the hall into the requested room and broadcasts the lobby update.
      Specified by:
      joinRoom in interface VirtualHallServer
      Parameters:
      hallJoinPacket - the packet containing the sender's nickname and the target room name.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the target room does not exist, or the player is not found in the hall.

    • createRoom

      public void createRoom(HallCreatePacket hallCreatePacket) throws Exception
      Processes a player's request to create a new game room. Initializes a WaitingRoom, moves the creator inside it, and broadcasts the hall update.
      Specified by:
      createRoom in interface VirtualHallServer
      Parameters:
      hallCreatePacket - the packet containing the sender's nickname, the room name, and its max capacity.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the player is not found in the hall.

    • giveMockupHall

      public MockupHall giveMockupHall()
      Generates a lightweight, serializable representation (Mockup) of the current hall state. This object is suitable for being transmitted over the network to the clients.
      Returns:
      a MockupHall containing the list of player nicknames and the status of active rooms.

    • broadcastMockupHall

      public void broadcastMockupHall() throws Exception
      Broadcasts the current hall state (as a Mockup) to all players currently waiting in the hall. If a player is unreachable during the broadcast, they are forcibly disconnected.
      Throws:
      Exception - if a critical network error occurs.

    • changeRoomIntoPlaying

      public void changeRoomIntoPlaying(String WaitingRoomName) throws Exception
      Converts a WaitingRoom into a PlayingRoom once it reaches the required conditions. Initializes the game controllers, replaces the room in the active rooms map, and starts the game loop in a new background thread.
      Parameters:
      WaitingRoomName - the name of the waiting room that is being changed into a playing room.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during room conversion or game initialization.

    • getRooms

      public Map<String,Room> getRooms()
      Retrieves the map of all currently active rooms.
      Returns:
      a map containing all the Room instances, indexed by their room names.
